prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1240; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on the date referenced in your file. Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event data recorder information, photographs, repair and total loss records, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster reports, telematics data, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Any alteration, deletion, or disposal of such materials may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
